fields.name: email
fields.help: Dropshipzone API user e-mail; POST /auth {email, password} returns a token valid 15 minutes, sent as `Authorization: jwt <token>` and renewed automatically.

me.note: Dropshipzone has no account endpoint; the probe logs in and lists the categories ([{category_id, title, parent_id, path}]), so `account` is empty on success.

list_products.note: GET /v2/products {result[{entity_id, sku, title, price, cost, RrpPrice, currency (AUD), stock_qty, status, gallery[], website_url, Category, brand, desc}], total, total_pages, current_page}. `query` is `keywords` (comma-separated, up to 20), `category` is category_id; the page size must be between 40 and 200 (default 40). `id` is the SKU (get_product and orders use SKUs).

get_product.note: GET /v2/products?skus={id}: the first result for that SKU ({sku, title, price, stock_qty, gallery, desc, weight, length, width, height, ...}); an unknown SKU is an empty result (invalid_input).

create_order.note: POST /placingOrder creates a 'Not Submitted' order that is only charged once paid on the Dropshipzone website. `shipping_address` uses Dropshipzone's consignee keys {first_name, last_name, address1, address2, suburb, state, postcode, telephone, comment} (Australian addresses); `items` are order_items [{sku, qty}]; your_order_no is a fresh UUID. The API answers HTTP 200 with [{status, serial_number, errmsg}]: result_status 1 is success, -1 a rejection explained in `errmsg`. `shipping_option` is not sent (no such field).

get_order.note: GET /orders?order_ids={id} (Dropshipzone order id): data[{increment_id, serial_number, status (unpaid, pending, processing, complete, canceled), created_at, grand_total (decimal string, AUD), items, shipment[{track_number, title, created_at}], shipping_address}].

track.note: The shipment[{track_number, title (carrier), created_at}] list of GET /orders?order_ids={order_id}; empty until the order is dispatched.

not_offered.quote_shipping: POST /v2/get_zone_rates takes skus and returns per-SKU rate tables keyed by Australian zone ({sku, standard{act, nsw_m, nsw_r, ..., nz}, defined{adelaide, brisbane, ...}}) after a postcode -> zone lookup (POST /v2/get_zone_mapping); there is no country-level options list for the product_id/country/quantity shape.
